title: Operators [Increment & Compound]
description:
## Increment & Decrement
- `x++` - adds 1 to x
- `x--` - subtracts 1 from x

## Compound Assignment
Instead of writing `x = x + 5`, you can write:
- `x += 5` (add)
- `x -= 5` (subtract)
- `x *= 5` (multiply)
- `x /= 5` (divide)
- `x %= 5` (modulo)

```csharp
int score = 100;
score += 50;   // 150
score -= 20;   // 130
score++;       // 131
score--;       // 130
```

## Assignment:
ChronoShard tracks a player's gold. Starting with 100 gold:
1. Add 50 using `+=`
2. Subtract 30 using `-=`
3. Double it using `*=`
4. Increment once with `++`
5. Print the final amount
